statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient reports recurrent episodes of palpitations accompanied by intermittent dizziness
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered for ambulatory assessment
The service is billed under diagnosis codes I34.0, R00.2, and R42
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
The symptoms are directly linked to the underlying condition, supporting the medical necessity of this service
